meta.checkpoints_on_output:
WARNING: checkpoints wear out SSDs and use extra GPU memory.
  Every 5m0s, each Guest session that uses checkpoints writes its whole state
  (parameters, optimizer state, buffers) to this machine's disk.
  If Guest state fills the GPU memory (12 GiB on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070), that is
  up to 143 GiB written per hour of use (3.4 TiB per day).
  Each GiB of Guest state writes 12 GiB per hour.
  While a checkpoint is copied, the GPU memory for the Guest's state doubles.
  Between disk writes, a checkpoint is taken every 1m0s and kept in RAM: up to the
  Guest's state size per session (twice that while a new one is written), at most half of the
  RAM workers may use, dropped first when the RAM rail needs the memory.
checkpoints on: one every 1m0s kept in RAM, written to disk every 5m0s
